description: Histogram with Points by MAQ Software Dive deeper into data distribution with our innovative Histogram with Points. Traditional histograms only show data density, but our custom visual goes further by pinpointing exact values within each range. This dual approach of combining histogram bars with specific data points offers a clearer understanding of data clusters, trends, and unique insights, ideal for precise data analysis. Key benefits Customizable visualization: Toggle between histogram bars and data points for tailored views. Hide/show them as needed. Flexible axis options: Configure X-axis and Y-axis (right or left) display options. Adjustable gridlines: Opt for visible or hidden gridlines to match your presentation style. Use cases Research: Find homogenized populations of customers (i.e., use Histogram with Points to see how the age, income, or education of your customers are clustered, and segment them into groups for further analysis). Marketing: Identify vital demographic clusters for promotional campaigns (i.e., use Histogram with Points to see how the preferences, behaviors, or satisfaction of your customers are distributed and target them with personalized offers or messages).
